name: Switch from B to C without changing forecast semantics
description: Verify B is dark navy and C is warm ivory with cyan line, and changing theme preserves source and cursor.
steps: Open the test site in default B and observe a navy chart, forecast line, shaded swing band and actual line.
Switch back to B and compare the displayed price and current time.
expected: C renders an ivory light chart with teal forecast and dark actual curve, while B uses navy with blue and green. The selected hour and illustrative price remain unchanged; no tables are displayed.

name: BTC ETH data toggle and hourly playback
description: Check asset controls and that forecast stays fixed when hourly actual series advances.
steps: Set slider near Monday and note the length of the actual line.
Click Afspil uge and then Stop, verifying that only actual line extends.
expected: Actual line grows hour by hour while the full forecast and intraday low/high envelope remain fixed; ETH shows distinct labelled simulated values.

name: Mobile minimalist layouts and bilingual controls
description: Ensure both distinct variants remain operable without horizontal scrolling on narrow iPhone-like viewport.
steps: Open on mobile and choose C.
Switch language to EN and inspect weekly graph labels.
Choose B, then BTC and ETH.
expected: No horizontal page overflow, plot and days are visible, navigation and buttons remain readable, and both Danish and English labels render correctly.

name: Fail-closed missing original forecast source
description: No prospective forecast line should appear when the source is explicitly marked unavailable.
steps: Inspect the forecast line, shaded low/high band and status text.
Click Vis forecast-design to restore the sample.
expected: Blue/teal forecast and shaded band disappear with a missing-original-source message while the actual path remains visible. Demo reappears only on explicit restore.
